target_dir.description: Directory for extracted metadata files. Empty string means current directory or original file replacement.

create_backups.description: Create backup files of original images when rewriting metadata.

fix_inconsistencies.description: Automatically fix metadata inconsistencies when possible.

extract_ext.description: File extension for standalone extracted metadata files.

append_extract_ext.description: Append the extract extension to the original filename instead of replacing the original extension.

dump_wrap_width.description: Max column width for wrapping dump output. 0 or empty disables wrapping.

include_exps.description: List of include filter expressions (e.g., 'IPTC.3:0-100'). If empty, defaults to 'all'. Items are strings.

exclude_exps.description: List of exclude filter expressions. If empty, defaults to 'none'.

edit_exps.description: List of edit expressions to add/modify metadata. If empty, defaults to 'none'.

check_compliance.description: Perform strict compliance checks against official metadata standards.

test_mode.description: If true, create *.rewrite files instead of overriding originals.

extract_type.description: Metadata type to extract. Supported: iptc.
